name: manual_b38436
claim: Before running a targeted flush-outbox, verify how the exact checked-out launcher and invocation load peer TLS, CA path and fingerprint, and bearer configuration. The November 15 report describes one invocation; it does not establish a general environment-only rule, a specific error for every missing value, or uniform behavior across launcher revisions. Refuse unverified transport and reconcile the targeted records before retrying.

decisions.notes: Preserve the historical observation and its lineage without treating an unverified configuration-loading claim as a general contract.

rationale: Preserve the historical observation and its lineage without treating an unverified configuration-loading claim as a general contract.
